layout: Float32 LE, row-major: index = row*cols+col, x = origin[0]+col*cell, z = origin[1]+row*cell (vertex grid)

zeroDatum.method: median DTM under SC+EN placement footprints

pad.shape: convex hull of the 8 placement footprints + buffer, plus spawn disc

source.name: 內政部20公尺網格數值地形模型資料 (MOI 20 m DTM), 分幅_高雄市DEM
source.crs: TWD97 / TM2 zone 121 (EPSG:3826), heights TWVD2001 metres; ASCII 'E N H' per line, 20 m spacing, -999 = no data (sea)

license: 政府資料開放授權條款－第1版 (Open Government Data License, Taiwan, v1.0); attribution: 內政部
note: Relative heights (science/engineering ground = 0). Sea = DTM no-data minus OSM roads/buildings, set to seabed. Lowland below 0 is vertically compressed by 0.110 so real sea level sits at seaLevel (true MSL is -5.45 relative). Hills unchanged; the 4 m grid resamples a 20 m DTM (bare earth). Road flattening not applied.
